subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: Should maintainers keep this issue as the canonical reaction-specific Slack Socket Mode investigation and gather live envelope proof before any fix PR?
rationale: Source inspection proves handler-level support but not live Socket Mode delivery, and choosing between reaction-specific diagnosis, broader Socket Mode liveness, or duplicate routing requires maintainer-held Slack proof and priority judgment.

options.title: Keep reaction issue canonical
options.body: Capture redacted current-main reaction_added/reaction_removed Socket Mode envelopes and gateway trace logs before changing code.

options.title: Fold into broader Socket Mode tracking
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89222 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/77249 only if live data shows a broader all-event or liveness failure rather than reaction-specific loss.

options.title: Close after live proof passes
options.body: Close only if a real current-main multi-account Slack workspace shows reactions arrive and route correctly with the reporter's documented config shape.

recommendation.title: Keep reaction issue canonical
recommendation.body: Capture redacted current-main reaction_added/reaction_removed Socket Mode envelopes and gateway trace logs before changing code.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining unknown boundary includes the multi-account mismatch filter and Slack monitor paths where steipete has the strongest history signal.
